q: From a list of Employee objects, print the average salary of the Tech department only.
code:
class Employee:
    def __init__(self, name, dept, salary):
        self.name, self.dept, self.salary = name, dept, salary

staff = [Employee("Rahul", "HR", 47764), Employee("Priya", "Tech", 62990),
         Employee("Amit", "Tech", 51200)]

tech = [e.salary for e in staff if e.dept == "Tech"]
print(sum(tech) / len(tech))

Make two objects from the same class and show that each keeps its own data.
code:
class Account:
    def __init__(self, owner, balance):
        self.owner   = owner
        self.balance = balance

    def deposit(self, amount):
        self.balance = self.balance + amount

a = Account("Rahul", 1000)
b = Account("Priya", 5000)
a.deposit(500)
print(a.owner, a.balance)
print(b.owner, b.balance)
